majorWarnings: Major Grafana releases may require dashboard or plugin updates.
Review https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/breaking-changes/ before approving.
Major Technitium DNS Server upgrades can change zone import behavior or API defaults.
Have a DNS rollback plan before approving.
Major Nextcloud upgrades run database migrations and may break third-party apps.
Review https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/stable/admin_manual/release_notes/ and back up data before approving.
Major Zitadel upgrades may require identity provider or login UI changes.
SSO for Grafana, Nextcloud, and Pterodactyl could be affected during migration.
Major Vaultwarden releases may change database schema or API compatibility.
Back up /vw-data before approving a major upgrade.
Major Synapse releases can require database migrations and federation config review.
Major Jellyfin releases may require client updates or plugin reinstallation.
Review https://jellyfin.org/docs/general/installation/ before approving.
Major Prometheus releases may deprecate PromQL features or change scrape behavior.
Review release notes and verify Ace alert rules after upgrading.
Major Pterodactyl panel upgrades rebuild the runtime image and run Laravel migrations.
Game servers and wings daemons may need coordinated updates; schedule downtime before approving.
Major notify_push releases must match your Nextcloud major version.
Approve only if Nextcloud itself is already on a compatible major release.
Caddy is supplied by nixpkgs; auto-updates require a full flake input bump.
